scope: local Camera2 source change and bounded phone integration check through a fake brightness file; no physical LED was enabled

change.new_stop_event: CameraCaptureSession.onCaptureCompleted for the one-shot still request, which reports capture completion after sensor exposure
change.analysis: YUV buffer analysis remains independent and runs after the illumination stop; pixel data is still analyzed in memory and discarded
change.failure_cleanup: capture failure, YUV reader exception, camera close, and the 850 ms app deadline still release the waiting helper; helper retains its one-second watchdog and exit cleanup

reason: Bound illumination to the sensor capture result rather than downstream buffer delivery and CPU image analysis. The change may reduce on-time and gives a better frame boundary, but callback latency and optical LED switching latency are still unmeasured.

phone_check.physical_leds: all four brightness values stayed at 0
phone_check.fake_helper_file: temporary regular file substituted for torch_0 sysfs node

limits: Camera2 capture-result completion is not a measurement of the optical LED falling edge.
SENSOR_INFO_TIMESTAMP_SOURCE_UNKNOWN prevents a proven cross-clock interval from helper timestamps to sensor exposure.
Brightness 14 is a previously observed minimum torch code, not a validated eye-safety limit.
The on-phone check used a regular fake brightness file, not the LED sysfs node; it verifies app/helper/callback ordering but not PMIC behavior or optical timing.
publication: local only; no commit, push, or PR
